visualCharacteristics.purpose: Share bar for article pages: a label plus share links for X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email and Copy link, with share URLs built from the current page
notes: Default (newsroom article): thin rounded beige bar under the article body; small uppercase label "SHARE THIS ARTICLE" left, row of round icon buttons right.
modal option (Sports Club article): outline pill "Share" button (beside a Back link that is default content) opens a dialog with heading Share and the icon links.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: cell 1 = label paragraph (e.g. Share this article); cell 2 = list of share links, one per network, link text naming the network (X or Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email, Copy link). The label and links may also be authored as a label row followed by one row per link. Authored hrefs only identify the network (e.g. https://twitter.com/intent/tweet, mailto:, #copy); the block rebuilds them from the current page URL and title
patterns: label left, round icon buttons right (default)
pill Share button opening an accessible dialog with the links (modal)
Copy link copies the page URL to the clipboard and announces "Link copied to clipboard"
blockContent: Share bar from cmp-c44-article-content: label + X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email, Copy link

options.label: Modal: a Share pill button that opens the links in a dialog

usage.description: Share links at the end of newsroom and Sports Club news articles.

reuseGuidance: Use once per article for social sharing. Use the modal option where the share links sit behind a Share button next to other article actions. Use columns for general side-by-side content.
